aggregate_non_regression: absolute calibration intercept must be no larger than legacy overlap comparator
absolute distance of calibration slope from 1 must be no larger than legacy overlap comparator
absolute observed-minus-predicted gap in the prediction-defined top decile must be no larger than legacy overlap comparator
top_decile_definition: probability threshold is the candidate or comparator's own 90th percentile, determined without outcomes; rows at or above threshold are exposure-weighted
gate_effect: all three diagnostics must pass separately for HR and Hits; no post-score recalibration or threshold change is allowed
